name: Glass-dried vaccine pack
subtitle: vaccines that need no cold chain

effects.effect: certain proteins turn glassy inside cells and let them survive drying out

effect: certain proteins turn glassy inside cells and let them survive drying out
how: Roughly half the world's vaccine doses are spoiled or thrown away because an unbroken chain of refrigerators has to reach the last village, and the chain breaks. Dried in a syrup of the tardigrade's own protective proteins, the delicate molecules of a vaccine are locked inside a glass so stiff that nothing can move or react, which is exactly how the animal survives years without water; a splash of sterile water reverses it at the clinic.
obstacle: Modern vaccines wrapped in fat bubbles, as the mRNA ones are, break as the glass forms, so each kind needs its own drying recipe proven over years.
why: Removes the refrigerator, which is the reason most missed vaccinations are missed.
real: Tardigrade CAHS D proteins have been shown to vitrify and protect a biologic - clotting factor VIII kept active through heat and dry storage - and the group proposes extending this to vaccines with an industry partner, but no tardigrade-protein-stabilised vaccine has been demonstrated.
